text:
Maya: morning async — quick standup (what I did / blockers / today)

Maya: yesterday: finished gateway route rewrite PR and kicked a canary rollforward. Blocker: seeing intermittent 429 spikes from a small set of long-tail clients. Started triage but need eyes on canary. Today: patch throttle heuristics + open follow-up PR for retry/backoff.

Sam: nice, link to the PR? I can review this morning. Also FYI I fixed a small bug in jwt-rotate service that caused short auth blips in staging.

Maya: PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4983 (needs changelog). @Sam can you watch the canary? gw-canary-2 CPU rising since 08:40.

Alex: on it, tailing logs now. If CPU keeps rising we can temporarily reduce batch latency via env override GATEWAY_BATCH_MS=8. Quick perf note: pushed a routing-policy micro-optim to fastpath header parsing (s/regex/fastpath/).

Jorge: blocker for me: rate-limiter tests flaking in CI. Repro shows a race in token-bucket refill on high-concurrency runs. I'll add a mutex + time-freeze test to stabilize. ETA EOD.

Anya: reviewed the auth patch, left one comment about oauth client cache TTL. Also forwarded a support ticket where a webhook consumer got repeated 429s — sharing details with @Maya.

deploy-bot: canary deploy 2026-03-16T09:12 — rollforward started — status: healthy (0/3 warnings)

Maya: thanks. if anyone sees the 429 pattern, please paste a minimal curl + headers here (no tokens) so we can match client behavior.

Sam: sample I captured (sanitized):
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' 'https://gw.redwood/api/v1/routeX'
# response: 429 Too Many Requests
# Retry-After: 1
```

Alex: thanks — short-term mitigation: set default Retry-After to 2s + small jitter on 429 responses and add a client-side exponential backoff suggestion header. Will open PR in a bit.

Jorge: CI note: will mark flakey rate-limiter tests with @flaky until fix merged so we don't block merges. Also adding a reproducer job.

Maya: summary/blockers: 429 spike (Maya + Alex), rate-limiter CI flakes (Jorge), jwt-rotate fallout already patched (Sam). Plan for today: merge gating PRs, monitor canary for 30m post-merge, ship throttle tweak if CPU settles. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Alex: lgtm, I’ll monitor and stand by to flip env if needed.

Sam: will review PR + follow up on jwt-rotate cleanup.

Anya: will coordinate with support on webhook consumer and share minimal logs.

Jorge: will post CI reproducer link when ready.

Maya: perfect — ping here with any quick updates, otherwise we’ll sync at the 3pm handoff.
